Specify unmatched outcomes, report domain and any acceptability-tie convention. Proposer optimality alone is not that proof. No group-strategy-proofness, hospital-capacity, ties or couples theorem unless actually proved.
scope: Develop finite DA termination/stability/proposer-optimality and the complete incentive result above; original instances and every blocking pair/feasible matching verified. Contrast recipient-side manipulation and changing constraints without a universal impossibility claim.

Cover assignment with a precise finite resource-allocation model and full optimality/price or combinatorial certificates. Distinguish stability without transfers from efficient assignment with transfers; do not invoke an unproved general LP integrality or existence theorem.

Cover network games and externalities with explicitly solved models, full best-response/global-equilibrium proofs, and changed assumptions showing where uniqueness/existence or welfare comparisons fail.

Possible six-case mix: two distinct matching designs, one assignment/pricing certificate, and three complementary/substitute/network-welfare interventions. Choose a coherent package from evidence; root reviews the blueprint before full authoring.
